high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "sweetishhousemafia." The post is sponsored, as indicated by the label at the top. The main focus of the image is a stack of dark chocolate sea salt vegan cookies placed on a teal-colored plate with a gold rim. The cookies appear to be golden brown with visible dark chocolate chips and a sprinkle of sea salt on top. The text overlay on the image reads "Dark Chocolate Sea Salt Vegan Cookies" in a bold, brown font.
